analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($203.15) vs SMA5/20/50 ($213.23/$221.39/$219.40): Confirmed below short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($214.36/$204.08): Entering weak mid-to-long-term trend zone.
· 52-week Position (49.2%) + Current price level near historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.1→34.1): Attempting to enter oversold territory.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.1589→-1.5775): Improving but still in negative territory.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near lower band $202.00) + Bandwidth 17.52% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($199.34): Based on 52-week low ($164.27) and 20-day low ($202.83).
· Swing Resistance ($212.19): Approaching SMA5 ($213.23) and SMA100 ($214.36) levels.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low ($202.83) is same as 20-day low ($202.83), failing to confirm Higher Low; 5-day high ($219.99) below 20-day high ($243.37) indicating Lower High pattern in progress.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.87x): Below average volume confirms lack of buying pressure.
· Current Stage Diagnosis: Attempting to enter accumulation phase but weak momentum persists; buy entry conditions not met, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
